In Proceedings of the 2026 International Workshop on Agentic Engineering (AGENT '26), ACM, pp. 63-67. https://doi.org/10.1145/3786167.3788412. Read from arXiv:2511.09268v2 [cs.SE], 25 May 2026

Evaluates — empirical repository-mining study of the content of 328 Claude.md configuration files (RQ1 concerns and practices, RQ2 code examples/links/diagrams, RQ3 co-occurrence patterns); no agent run, effect of the files not measured
Claude Code configuration files (Claude.md / CLAUDE.md); no version

A single Markdown configuration file read by Claude Code for each request: bash commands, code style, workflow guidelines, project structure (Fig. 1 example). Observed concerns (Fig. 2, text): Software Architecture 72.6% (238 files), Development Guidelines 44.8%, Project Overview 39%, Testing 35.4%, Commands 33.2%, Dependencies 30.8%, General Guidelines 25.6%, Integration and Usage Guidelines 18% each, Configuration 17.4%. 45 files were 'memory banks' pointing to other Markdown files

Initial study; classification by one author (reviewed by two); results may change as agents evolve. Future work: PR discussions about agent configuration, evolution of the files, a tool recommending best practices for writing configuration files

Short paper (5 pages). Abstract and Section 3 mention two RQs while the introduction lists three (RQ1-RQ3). Fig. 2 percentages partly given in text only for the top categories; full distribution value in Fig. 2 only. Table 2 caption: percentages 'of the instances classified in this category', text says 'of the files' for links (unclear unit). Replication package: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.17388127. No pre-registration. Programming language: 23 languages in the repositories; no agent run
